body:
MAINLINE-068 is filed. Literature arithmetic only. QUESTIONABLE. PROJECTION. No qualified hull safety factor.

The index is density over modulus to the power 0.514, on 290 GPa and 1850 kg/m3. The payloads behind 993 and 1146 kg/m3 sit at 293.6 GPa and 379.2 MPa. Concept still needs 1.863 and TRL 7 still needs 1.614. Both lines are the local slope, not a re-optimised clear.

Measured membranes, by the concept multiplier still needed: graphite film 1.219, CVD diamond 1.827, SR-200 1.863, AlBeMet AM162 sheet 2.571, plate-nanolattice 3.030. The film is 969 GPa at 2.25 g/cm3 (DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-62227-6), improvement 1.529, TRL 7 multiplier 1.056. Gauges opened are about 2 to 145 µm, against 2.09 and 3.15 mm, and the test is tension.

CNT yarn does not pass it. Unidirectional means score 1.430 and 1.441 and are not a membrane. A cross-ply with transverse stiffness neglected projects to about 1.00, and a quasi-isotropic layup to about 0.81. Those moduli were not read. A cross-ply cannot lead unless it exceeds the opened unidirectional modulus.

No beryllium sheet at 993 or 1146 kg/m3 was opened. Pyrolytic-carbon lattices stay near 0.61. A stretch-dominated architecture that hits the concept line is not built.

T3 and T7 stay on SR-200 bonded to CR-III. The research direction is the graphite film. Its first coupon is in-plane compression of a stack near 2.1 mm, reporting modulus, density and compressive strength. No purchase. Area, the bond and thermal expansion are unshown. The 1.07 interface is the beryllium case.
